reference_description: The plot illustrates the absolute mean values of hidden states across different layers, providing a comparison before and after a gate, as well as against a baseline. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 25 with tick labels marked at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 5 with tick labels at intervals of 1. There are three lines depicted in the plot. The blue dashed line, which represents the "hidden state mean before gate," starts with abosulte mean value close to 0 at layer 0 and exhibits a generally steady trend until around layer 17, where it climbs significantly, peaking at about 4.3 by layer 23. Both the solid green line and the dotted orange line, representing "hidden state mean of baseline" and "hidden state mean after gate" respectively, remain relatively constant at 0 accross all layers.
